name: list_tasks
description: List housekeeping tasks at one property. The platform returns them HIGH priority first then oldest; your job is to re-sequence that into an efficient route, not to re-sort by priority again. Task records carry roomNumber, priority, taskType, status, and assignedTo.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property. This selects which housekeeping identity the call signs in as, so it is required on every tool and is not merely a filter.

status.description: Task status filter. One of PENDING, ASSIGNED, CLEANING, COMPLETED, INSPECTING, INSPECTED, DIRTY.

priority.description: Priority filter. One of HIGH, NORMAL, LOW.

assignedTo.description: Filter to one housekeeper by name. Free text; only use names already seen in task output.

name: get_task
description: Fetch one housekeeping task in full, including its room number and current status. Use this to confirm state before assigning, completing, or inspecting.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property the task belongs to.

name: room_board
description: Room status board for one property: total rooms, occupancy percent, per-status counts, and every room's number, floor, type and status. The floor field is what makes same-floor batching possible and is the only room attribute beyond number, type and status that any endpoint exposes.

name: assign_task
description: Assign a PENDING or ASSIGNED task to a named housekeeper. Auto-executes without human approval. Any other current status returns 409 INVALID_STATE, which is information for you, not an error to retry. The platform has no staff roster, skills data, or shift data, so you may only use housekeeper names you have already seen in task output. Never invent a name.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property the task belongs to.

taskId.description: UUID of the task to assign.

assignedTo.description: Housekeeper name, max 100 characters. Must be a name already present in this property's task data.

name: complete_task
description: Mark cleaning complete on a task in ASSIGNED or CLEANING. Advances the room through the platform's workflow to INSPECTING. Any other current status returns 409 INVALID_STATE.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property the task belongs to.

notes.description: Optional free-text note about the clean.

name: inspect_task
description: Pass or fail inspection on a task in INSPECTING. Passing marks the room INSPECTED and available; failing sends it back to DIRTY and re-opens cleaning, so a fail is a real operational decision that costs a turn. Any other current status returns 409 INVALID_STATE.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property the task belongs to.

passed.description: True to pass inspection, false to fail it and send the room back to DIRTY.

notes.description: Optional free-text note. Supply one whenever passed is false, so a human can see why.
